findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: brazil_compare_regions, brazil_contract_intent_a2a · Public sink: brazil_tax_anatomy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: brazil_compare_regions, brazil_contract_intent_a2a · Public sink: brazil_tax_anatomy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
